offering_description.value: Underwrites title insurance, mortgage guaranty insurance and general property and casualty insurance, selling to homebuyers, mortgage lenders, businesses and individuals through agents, brokers and its own offices.

primary_products.value: title insurance; mortgage guaranty insurance; commercial general liability insurance; workers' compensation insurance; commercial auto insurance

primary_services.value: title search and escrow services; claims administration; risk management services

customer_segment.value: B2B: mortgage lenders, title agents, employers, commercial fleet operators, contractors; B2C: homebuyers and individual property owners, drivers

end_markets.value: real estate; mortgage lending; construction; transportation; manufacturing

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: insurance premiums for title, mortgage guaranty and general insurance policies; service fees: title search, closing and escrow fees charged to buyers and lenders

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes in insurance premiums and pays claims on policies sold to homebuyers, lenders and businesses; service provider: performs title searches and closing services for real estate transactions

geography_served.value: US national: all 50 states and Puerto Rico

specialization.value: diversified: separate title insurance, mortgage guaranty and general insurance businesses with different customers

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: independent title insurance agents and closing firms; agents / brokers: independent insurance agents and brokers for general and commercial lines; direct sales: national accounts and large mortgage lenders; own locations: company-owned title insurance and escrow offices
distribution_channels.category: partners / resellers; agents / brokers; direct sales; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance business licensed and supervised by state insurance departments under NAIC-based rules
